name: kvCORE
description: kvCORE is Inside Real Estate's platform for real-estate lead generation, IDX websites, CRM, automated follow-up, marketing, listings, transactions, business analytics and brokerage operations.
agentUseSummary: kvCORE is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not collect or use its role-inherited bearer tokens until Inside Real Estate documents least-privilege scopes, immutable account binding and a production third-party token lifecycle.

capabilities.label: Review bounded kvCORE CRM access
capabilities.description: If a least-privilege authorization contract becomes available, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted read tools after product and security review.

blocked.label: Capture a kvCORE API token
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an agent, team, office, company or super-account administrator to paste a broad bearer token into this Marketplace preview.

blocked.label: Read private real-estate CRM data
blocked.description: Lead and contact identity, communications, search alerts, tasks, calls, timelines, transactions and other client data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Administer kvCORE accounts or switch context
blocked.description: Creating, updating or deleting offices, teams and users, changing roles, or using super-account headers to act in a child account is unavailable.

blocked.label: Change records or contact people
blocked.description: Listing, open-house, contact, website, testimonial, transaction and campaign mutations or outbound communications are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run kvCORE actions before security review
blocked.description: No kvCORE tool is callable until Inside Real Estate documents granular scopes, exact tenant binding, token issuance, rotation, revocation, expiration, limits and third-party distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: kvCORE authorization security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because documented API tokens inherit broad user or administrator authority without a public granular-scope lifecycle.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under kvCORE's documented role-inherited bearer-token contract.
No Hermes tools are callable under kvCORE's documented role-inherited bearer-token contract.

providerSetup.blocker: kvCORE Public API V2 authenticates with bearer API tokens generated for a user and inherits that user's role. The documented surface includes private contacts and communications, writes, account administration and super-account headers that can switch into child accounts. Public materials do not define granular scopes, immutable tenant claims, expiration, rotation, revocation or a safe distributable authorization flow.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Inside Real Estate for a production third-party authorization contract with granular read scopes, immutable account/user claims, no super-account context switching, secure issuance, expiration, rotation and revocation, rate limits, audit identifiers and distribution terms. Re-run privacy and security review before implementing only typed, bounded and redacted read tools.

evidence.supports: kvCORE Public API V2 uses bearer API tokens generated by the kvCORE application for a user and documents account, listing, open-house, contact, analytics, transaction and website surfaces.

The permission tables make token authority depend on user role; company administrators receive broad create, update, delete and read access, while super-account tokens can switch child-account context with headers.
Inside Real Estate describes kvCORE as an all-in-one brokerage platform spanning lead generation, websites, CRM, marketing automation, listings, transactions and business analytics.

Inside Real Estate identifies CRM contacts, emails, calendars, files, account credentials and other client information as personal data processed by its services, reinforcing the need for bounded authorization and redaction.
